description: Election Commission - Declare that P. Nishanthini as a Member of the Valikamam-East Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam East Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a recognized political party, and the formal declaration of a new member to fill the vacancy. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
